notes.title: Devlog #01 - Butterflies!
notes.content:
[h3]Thank You for Your Support![/h3]
A huge thank you to everyone for the incredible support during [b]Steam Next Fest 2025[/b]—we've officially reached [b]10,000 wishlists!![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202587/b2c52f7bc40971df507ef1aa0d471ba6203caea0.png[/img]

[h3]Introducing... Butterflies![/h3]
We're kicking off our [b]monthly devlogs[/b] starting with something new: [b]butterflies![/b]
[list]
[*] Different butterfly species will now flutter around your garden.
[*] Catch them by interacting and successfully clearing the [b]bug-catching minigame![/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202587/61920db21461d321a5ac643cce1eeab9569664bd.gif[/img]

[h3]Bug-Catching Minigame[/h3]
[list]
[*]A timing challenge that mimics the unpredictable movement of critters.
[*]Complete the patterns with multiple times of [b]well-timed clicks[/b] to successfully catch them.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202587/f72289df07d4053bd4b7a823646220c705dbc855.gif[/img]

[h3]Critters Collection Book & Rewards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Successfully caught critters are added to your [b]Critters Collection Book.[/b]
[*] Expanding your collection unlocks [b]new bouquet decorations![/b]
[*] The critters come in different rarities—get ready to [b]Catch 'Em All![/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202587/91aaa733cad2e5bbd5a092b6cd9cab0206dc63bb.gif[/img]

This new feature will be available in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3473530/BloomTale_Demo/]BloomTale Demo[/url] soon! 

We can't wait for you to try out the butterfly catching and see what you think. 
That's all for this month's devlog. Until next time, happy arranging!

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Bouquet Editor Update:[/b] Layering system & QoL improvements
[*] [b]In-Game SNS:[/b] Share your bouquet with the world!
[*] [b]Endless Mode:[/b] A new challenge for dedicated florists
[*] [b]Localization System:[/b] Bringing BloomTale to more players globally
[/list]
